items.excerpt: Apple's first iOS 27 public beta is live, headlined by the rebuilt Siri AI: it can hold ongoing conversations, search your personal data, read on-screen content and take in-app actions — the biggest on-device Apple Intelligence overhaul yet.

Official-looking renders of Samsung's Galaxy Z Flip 8, Z Fold 8, Watch 9 and Watch Ultra 2 leaked ahead of the July 22 Unpacked, giving the first full look at the Galaxy AI foldable and wearable lineup in its final colors and designs.

Samsung set Galaxy Unpacked for July 22 in London, with a teaser that unfolds into the Galaxy AI logo — signaling Z Fold 8, Z Flip 8, new Galaxy Watches and its rumored first smart glasses as an AI-first hardware push.

Samsung officially teased the Galaxy Watch 9 as an 'AI-powered health companion,' confirming all-new internals, a Snapdragon Wear Elite chip, a Vitals metric bundle and Gemini raise-to-talk ahead of Unpacked.

Samsung's teaser frames the next Galaxy Watch as an always-on gateway for personalized AI health, promising 'all-new internal components,' longer battery life and more accurate tracking to power real-time on-wrist AI insights.

Meta is patching its Ray-Ban AI glasses to disable the camera if the recording LED is tampered with, after a modding scene sold LED-kill services — reigniting the debate over whether cameraless AI glasses are the safer design future.
Meta will push a software update that disables the camera on its Ray-Ban smart glasses if the capture LED is damaged or covered, closing a privacy hole exploited by a paid modding community.

A hands-on review of Google's first ground-up Gemini smart speaker — the $99 Home Speaker with a dedicated NPU for on-device AI processing, 360-degree audio and Gemini-driven conversational control of the home.

Roborock's Saros 20 uses AI object recognition to identify and dodge 300+ obstacle types, plus solid-state lidar and a climbing chassis — a review of how far on-device AI has pushed robot-vacuum autonomy in 2026.

Microsoft's 2026 Surface Laptop 13.8 gets Qualcomm's new Snapdragon X2 Plus, delivering a big NPU/CPU jump for Copilot+ on-device AI — a review of what the next-gen Arm silicon means for AI PC performance.
